title: JPL
description: Contract full stack engineering role focused on implementing support apps for labs scientists to improve their day to day work.
content:
# Working at JPL


The division I worked in, OCIO at the time, focused on delivering internal tooling and custom software applications to the rest of the lab and scientists. My team specifically had a specialized stack in Django + React + Postgres applications that solved needs for MARS2020 and other groups.


## IADS Dashboard - System Consolidation


This dashboard focused on consolidating application data from about 4 separate (and older) applications into a single, visually pleasing dashboard. 


The intent was to provide a centralized application where team users could track multiple tickets simultaneously without having to sign-in and remember the flows for all the individual apps.


![System Design Diagram for IADS Dashboard](/images/content/jpl/jpl-0.jpg)


## WSPR - Waiver Signing


A lot of projects on JPL laboratory would go through very specific document flows that were internal. The waivers initially were paper-only. TBT.


To speed up the lab we built a a React / Django application that provided these documents and signing capabilities to JPL teams at large.
